summary: ansible-galaxy ships with Ansible and installs roles from Galaxy or Git. It talks to galaxy.ansible.com by default; use --server or ansible.cfg to point at an internal Galaxy server.
questions: How do I use a private Galaxy server instead of galaxy.ansible.com?
Can ansible-galaxy install roles straight from Git?
Do I need to install ansible-galaxy separately?

answer_card.title: Point ansible-galaxy at another server
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible-galaxy` comes with Ansible and defaults to `https://galaxy.ansible.com`. To use your own Galaxy server pass `--server <address>`, or set the server permanently in `ansible.cfg` (see `galaxy_server`).
